name: Masako Gibu
source:
A 2nd year high school student. Born into a lineage that has been serving the village head's family for a long time, she's been Natsuki's caretaker from a young age. She's a cool beauty who doesn't say much.

[Translated from [url=https://ahonojuge00.wixsite.com/rinjou-stargazer]official website[/url]]
